rv.q: In a world that can sometimes feel determined to remind us of everything that divides us, Come From Away is two hours honoring those who did exactly that.
"Come From Away" is a toe-tapping, funny, sweet and healing balm for the soul.
Ultimately, the story — one of resilience, care, and community — forges a family of the audience as well.

cn.t: Critics praise this moving musical about post-9/11 kindness as a balm for the soul, with strong harmonies and quiet emotional moments that remind audiences heroism comes from everyday compassion.
